description: The Figma dashboard (file GrKk5YyfJcDRdPBr7xXTF9): sidebar shell (TASK-023 in EPIC-2), summary cards, the leave calendar, upcoming leave, recent activity and the request detail page. Each slice gets its own PRD story and task.

summary: Dashboard leave calendar (month view, scoped by role)
description: Month calendar on the dashboard from Figma frames 14:8878 and 14:9401. New scoped month query (employee: own; manager: own plus direct reports via users.manager_id; HR: everyone), pure layout helpers (month grid, week segments, lanes), previous/next/Today as links with ?month=YYYY-MM, a rejected toggle with ?rejected=1, a legend, and a text list for screen readers. APP_TIMEZONE (optional, default UTC) decides today. Bars have no link until the request detail page exists. Out of scope: an HR employee filter, a '+N more' cap, upcoming leave, recent activity.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an employee sees only their own requests as spans, coloured by type, approved solid and pending striped;AC2: a manager sees own plus direct reports only and another team's request (Leo) never appears;AC3: HR sees every employee's requests;AC4: rejected requests are hidden unless the toggle is on;AC5: previous, next and Today change the month and today is highlighted;AC6: usable at 375px and 320px without horizontal scroll and every request is also available as text

summary: Dashboard upcoming leave list (scoped by role)
description: Upcoming leave card from Figma frames 14:9341 and 14:9638 (below the calendar). New scoped query (employee: own; manager: own plus direct reports via users.manager_id; HR: everyone) for pending and approved, not deleted, end_date >= today, soonest first, limit 5, scope in the SQL. Date tile (the later of start and today), name (with 'You' for the viewer), range, type and status as text. No row link and no 'View all' until a request details page exists. Streamed in its own Suspense with a skeleton; a failed read shows 'not available'.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an employee sees only their own pending and approved upcoming requests, at most five;AC2: a manager sees own plus direct reports only and another team's request (Leo) never appears;AC3: HR sees everyone;AC4: rejected, cancelled and finished requests are not listed and one under way today is;AC6: status is text;AC7: a failed read shows 'not available' without breaking the page and an empty list says so;AC8: usable at 375px and 320px

summary: Dashboard recent activity feed (scoped by role)
description: Recent activity card from Figma frames 14:9376 and 14:9673. New scoped query over audit_log joined to the request, its owner, the actor and the leave type (employee: own requests; manager: own plus direct reports via users.manager_id; HR: everyone), newest first, limit 5, scope in the SQL. Events submitted, approved, rejected and cancelled with an icon, a coloured text label, a sentence ('Priya Shah submitted Vacation · Oct 19-21') and the time in APP_TIMEZONE ('Today, Oct 15 · 9:42 AM'). Icons send, x and check exported from Figma. No migration. Streamed in its own Suspense with a skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: a manager sees events for own plus direct reports only and another team's request (Leo) never appears;AC3: HR sees everyone;AC5: newest first, at most five, each with who, what, type, dates and time in the app time zone;AC6: each event is labelled in text;AC7: a failed read shows 'not available' without breaking the page and an empty list says so;AC8: usable at 375px and 320px
